[4](#4)use camel_api::CamelError;
[5](#5)use camel_dsl::SecurityCompileContext;
[6](#6)use std::sync::Arc;
[7](#7)
[8](#8)fn native_authenticator(
[13](#13)    native: &camel_config::config::NativeAuthConfig,
[14](#14)) -> Result<Arc<dyn camel_auth::TokenAuthenticator>, CamelError> {
[15](#15)    let token = native.bearer_token.clone().ok_or_else(|| {
[16](#16)        CamelError::Config("security.native.bearer_token is required for route auth".into())
[17](#17)    })?;
[18](#18)    let principal = camel_api::security_policy::Principal {
[19](#19)        subject: native.subject.clone(),
[20](#20)        issuer: native.issuer.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| "native".into()),
[21](#21)        audience: Vec::new(),
[22](#22)        roles: native.roles.clone(),
[23](#23)        scopes: native.scopes.clone(),
[24](#24)        claims: serde_json::Value::Object(serde_json::Map::new()),
[25](#25)    };
[26](#26)    let store = camel_auth::native_auth::NativeCredentialStore::try_new(vec![
[27](#27)        camel_auth::NativeCredential {
[28](#28)            secret: camel_auth::NativeCredentialSecret::Plaintext { value: token },
[29](#29)            principal,
[30](#30)        },
[31](#31)    ])?;
[32](#32)    Ok(Arc::new(camel_auth::StaticTokenAuthenticator::new(store)))
[33](#33)}
[34](#34)
[35](#35)fn keycloak_authenticator(
[36](#36)    keycloak: &camel_config::config::KeycloakSecurityConfig,
[37](#37)) -> Result<Arc<dyn camel_auth::TokenAuthenticator>, CamelError> {
[38](#38)    let realm = camel_component_keycloak::KeycloakRealmConfig::new(
[39](#39)        keycloak.server_url.clone(),
[40](#40)        keycloak.realm.clone(),
[41](#41)        keycloak.client_id.clone(),
[42](#42)    )
[43](#43)    .with_client_secret(keycloak.client_secret.clone());
[44](#44)
[45](#45)    match keycloak.validation.method.as_str() {
[46](#46)        "local" => {
[47](#47)            let jwks = Arc::new(
[48](#48)                camel_auth::RemoteJwksProvider::new(realm.jwks_uri())
[49](#49)                    .map_err(|e| CamelError::Config(e.to_string()))?,
[50](#50)            );
[51](#51)            let mapper = Arc::new(camel_auth::JsonPointerClaimsMapper::new(
[52](#52)                camel_component_keycloak::keycloak_claim_paths(&keycloak.client_id),
[53](#53)            ));
[54](#54)            Ok(Arc::new(camel_auth::LocalJwtValidator::new(
[55](#55)                keycloak.validation.audience.clone(),
[56](#56)                realm.realm_url(),
[57](#57)                jwks,
[58](#58)                mapper,
[59](#59)            )))
[60](#60)        }
[61](#61)        "introspection" => {
[62](#62)            let opts = camel_auth::IntrospectionCacheOptions {
[63](#63)                max_entries: keycloak.introspection.max_entries,
[64](#64)                default_ttl: std::time::Duration::from_secs(
[65](#65)                    keycloak.introspection.default_ttl_secs,
[66](#66)                ),
[67](#67)                negative_ttl: std::time::Duration::from_secs(
[68](#68)                    keycloak.introspection.negative_ttl_secs,
[69](#69)                ),
[70](#70)            };
[71](#71)            let auth = realm.introspection_authenticator(opts)?;
[72](#72)            Ok(Arc::new(auth))
[73](#73)        }
[74](#74)        other => Err(CamelError::Config(format!(
[75](#75)            "unsupported security.keycloak.validation.method: {other}"
[76](#76)        ))),
[77](#77)    }
[78](#78)}
[79](#79)
[80](#80)fn resolve_authenticator(
[86](#86)    security: &camel_config::config::SecurityConfig,
[87](#87)) -> Result<Option<Arc<dyn camel_auth::TokenAuthenticator>>, CamelError> {
[88](#88)    let has_keycloak = security.keycloak.is_some();
[89](#89)    let has_oidc = security.oidc.is_some();
[90](#90)    let has_native = security.native.is_some();
[91](#91)
[92](#92)    let count = [has_keycloak, has_oidc, has_native]
[93](#93)        .iter()
[94](#94)        .filter(|&&x| x)
[95](#95)        .count();
[96](#96)    if count > 1 {
[97](#97)        return Err(CamelError::Config(
[98](#98)            "configure only one of security.keycloak, security.oidc, security.native for route authentication"
[99](#99)                .into(),
[100](#100)        ));
[101](#101)    }
[102](#102)
[103](#103)    if let Some(ref keycloak) = security.keycloak {
[104](#104)        Ok(Some(keycloak_authenticator(keycloak)?))
[105](#105)    } else if let Some(ref native) = security.native {
[106](#106)        Ok(Some(native_authenticator(native)?))
[107](#107)    } else {
[108](#108)        Ok(None)
[110](#110)    }
[111](#111)}
[112](#112)
[113](#113)fn register_keycloak_uma_evaluator(
[116](#116)    camel_config: &camel_config::config::CamelConfig,
[117](#117)    evaluator_registry: &camel_auth::PermissionEvaluatorRegistry,
[118](#118)) -> Result<(), CamelError> {
[119](#119)    if let Some(ref keycloak) = camel_config.security.keycloak
[120](#120)        && let Some(ref uma) = keycloak.uma
[121](#121)    {
[122](#122)        let realm = camel_component_keycloak::KeycloakRealmConfig::new(
[123](#123)            keycloak.server_url.clone(),
[124](#124)            keycloak.realm.clone(),
[125](#125)            keycloak.client_id.clone(),
[126](#126)        )
[127](#127)        .with_client_secret(keycloak.client_secret.clone());
[128](#128)        let evaluator = realm
[129](#129)            .uma_evaluator()
[130](#130)            .map_err(|e| CamelError::Config(e.to_string()))?;
[131](#131)        evaluator_registry.register(uma.provider.clone(), evaluator);
[132](#132)    }
[133](#133)    Ok(())
[134](#134)}
[135](#135)
[136](#136)#[cfg(feature = "wasm")]
[141](#141)pub async fn build_security_compile_context_from_config(
[142](#142)    camel_config: &camel_config::config::CamelConfig,
[143](#143)    registry: Arc<std::sync::Mutex<camel_core::Registry>>,
[144](#144)) -> Result<SecurityCompileContext, CamelError> {
[145](#145)    let authenticator = resolve_authenticator(&camel_config.security)?;
[146](#146)    let mut security_ctx = SecurityCompileContext::new(authenticator, None);
[147](#147)
[148](#148)    let evaluator_registry = camel_auth::PermissionEvaluatorRegistry::new();
[149](#149)
[150](#150)    if let Some(ref policies) = camel_config.security.policies {
[151](#151)        let policy_registry =
[152](#152)            camel_component_wasm::build_security_policy_registry(&policies.wasm, registry.clone())
[153](#153)                .await
[154](#154)                .map_err(|e| CamelError::Config(e.to_string()))?;
[155](#155)        if !policy_registry.is_empty() {
[156](#156)            security_ctx = security_ctx.with_security_policy_registry(Arc::new(policy_registry));
[157](#157)        }
[158](#158)    }
[159](#159)
[160](#160)    if let Some(ref permissions) = camel_config.security.permissions {
[161](#161)        let wasm_registry = camel_component_wasm::build_permission_registry(permissions, registry)
[162](#162)            .await
[163](#163)            .map_err(|e| CamelError::Config(e.to_string()))?;
[164](#164)        for (name, evaluator) in wasm_registry.entries() {
[165](#165)            evaluator_registry.register(name, evaluator);
[166](#166)        }
[167](#167)    }
[168](#168)
[169](#169)    register_keycloak_uma_evaluator(camel_config, &evaluator_registry)?;
[170](#170)
[171](#171)    if !evaluator_registry.is_empty() {
[172](#172)        security_ctx = security_ctx.with_evaluator_registry(Arc::new(evaluator_registry));
[173](#173)    }
[174](#174)
[175](#175)    Ok(security_ctx)
[176](#176)}
[177](#177)
[178](#178)#[cfg(not(feature = "wasm"))]
[179](#179)pub async fn build_security_compile_context_from_config(
[180](#180)    camel_config: &camel_config::config::CamelConfig,
[181](#181)    _registry: Arc<std::sync::Mutex<camel_core::Registry>>,
[182](#182)) -> Result<SecurityCompileContext, CamelError> {
[183](#183)    if camel_config.security.permissions.is_some() {
[184](#184)        return Err(CamelError::Config(
[185](#185)            "security.permissions requires camel-cli wasm feature".into(),
[186](#186)        ));
[187](#187)    }
[188](#188)
[189](#189)    if camel_config.security.policies.is_some() {
[190](#190)        return Err(CamelError::Config(
[191](#191)            "security.policies requires camel-cli wasm feature".into(),
[192](#192)        ));
[193](#193)    }
[194](#194)
[195](#195)    let authenticator = resolve_authenticator(&camel_config.security)?;
[196](#196)    let mut security_ctx = SecurityCompileContext::new(authenticator, None);
[197](#197)
[198](#198)    let evaluator_registry = camel_auth::PermissionEvaluatorRegistry::new();
[199](#199)
[200](#200)    register_keycloak_uma_evaluator(camel_config, &evaluator_registry)?;
[201](#201)
[202](#202)    if !evaluator_registry.is_empty() {
[203](#203)        security_ctx = security_ctx.with_evaluator_registry(Arc::new(evaluator_registry));
[204](#204)    }
[205](#205)
[206](#206)    Ok(security_ctx)
[207](#207)}

[364](#364)        let evaluators = ctx.evaluator_registry.expect("evaluator registry");
[365](#365)        assert!(evaluators.get("keycloak-uma").is_some());
[366](#366)    }

# cu-sdlogger 1.0.0 - Docs.rs

Source: https://docs.rs/crate/cu-sdlogger/1.0.0

# cu-sdlogger

Utilities for writing Copper unified logs to an SD/eMMC partition from embedded targets. It builds on `embedded_sdmmc::BlockDevice` and speaks the Cu29 on-disk format used by the runtime log reader.

## What it provides

- `find_copper_partition`: scan the GPT and return the start/length of the Cu29 partition.
- `EMMCLogger`:- `UnifiedLogWrite<EMMCSectionStorage<_>>`implementation that lays out the main header and log sections on a block device.
- `EMMCSectionStorage`: section writer that encodes entries with bincode.
- `ForceSyncSend`: wrapper for sharing block devices with serialized access.

## Usage

```
use ;
use *;
use SdCard;
// 1) Wrap your block device if it is not Sync and access is serialized.
let sd = new;
// 2) Locate the Copper partition (GUID 29A2E0C9-0000-4C75-9229-000000000029).
let Some = find_copper_partition? else ;
// 3) Create the logger and allocate a section for your stream.
let mut logger:  = new?;
let mut telem = logger.add_section?; // bytes of payload
// 4) Append log entries and flush before shutdown.
telem.append?;
logger.flush_section;
```
Notes:

- Blocks are assumed to be 512 bytes; the logger errors if it would run out of space.
- `append`and- `flush_section`use bincode encoding and update the section header to keep usage counters accurate.
- `ForceSyncSend`does not provide locking; use it only with single-threaded or externally synchronized access.
- See `examples/cu_rp2350_skeleton`and`examples/cu_elrs_bdshot_demo``CuApplication`.

---
